title: Oven Roasted French Wild Garlic Bouillabaisse
description: A hearty, herbal French stew featuring wild garlic leaves, served with a low-glycemic-friendly ssam-wrap, perfect for a lazy Sunday. This dish is a creative twist on the classic bouillabaisse, with a focus on fresh, seasonal ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the wild garlic leaves with olive oil, salt, and pepper, and spread on a baking sheet to roast for 10 minutes.
In a large pot, saute the onions and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the mussels and cod to the pot, and cook until the seafood is opaque and the mussels are open, about 5 minutes.
Add the roasted wild garlic leaves and vegetable broth to the pot, and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 10 minutes.
Season the bouillabaisse with salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Serve the bouillabaisse in bowls, with ssam wraps on the side for wrapping.
Garnish with additional wild garlic leaves, if desired.
